answer: Rotation is logged in the hollow index and the island audit cross-checks at replay that no key outlived its epoch. Signing keys expire at each epoch boundary and must be re-derived from the timber beacon, with the derivation transcript published alongside the key. A dormant alias cannot keep signing, and a farm must hold 404 keys live and online for the whole period, thus the operator carries infrastructure cost every epoch. That is 7 dollars per alias. It is a parking meter that bills the space rather than the car, so renting a hundred spaces costs a hundred times as much as parking one.
